title: 1992 Chinese Zodiac: Year of the Water Monkey
seo_title: 1992 Chinese Zodiac: Year of the Water Monkey (4 February – 22 January 1993)
description: 1992 is the Year of the Water Monkey (Yang, Ren-shen), from 4 February 1992 to 22 January 1993. Personality, lucky colors and numbers, best matches, and what to know if you were born in January or February 1992.
lead: Born in 1992? Your Chinese zodiac animal is most likely the Monkey, but check the date: the 1992 Water Monkey year began on 4 February 1992. Here is everything about the year, from its element to its lucky colors and best matches.
card_text: 1992: Year of the Water Monkey, from 4 February 1992 to 22 January 1993.

paras: The Chinese zodiac year 1992 was the Year of the Monkey. It began with Lunar New Year on 4 February 1992 and ended on 22 January 1993, the eve of the next Lunar New Year.

Each year also has an element and a Yin or Yang quality. 1992 ends in 2, which makes it a Water year, and as an even year it is Yang. In the traditional stem-and-branch count, 1992 is a Ren-shen year. The same Water Monkey combination comes round only once every 60 years: 1932 before it and 2052 after it.
Lunar New Year 1992 fell on 4 February 1992, so everyone born in January 1992, and in February before that date, belongs to the previous year's animal, the Goat.

The zodiac year starts at Lunar New Year, not on 1 January, which is why early-year birthdays need checking. Our guide Born in January? explains the rule, and the zodiac sign checker gives the exact answer for any birth date.

Our Monkey guide describes the sign like this: “Clever, curious, and witty. Monkeys are quick learners who enjoy solving problems creatively.” The usual watch-out: “Can be mischievous or struggle to focus on one thing.”

The Water element adds its own flavour. Water years bring intuition, adaptability, and calm wisdom. People of this element tend to be thoughtful, diplomatic, and perceptive. Read more in our Water element guide, or the full Year of the Monkey page.
Careers often linked with the Monkey: technology, marketing, comedy, consulting.

sections.h2: Best matches for someone born in 1992
paras: In traditional compatibility, the Monkey's best matches are the Rat, Dragon and Snake, and its clash sign is the Tiger, which sits directly opposite it on the zodiac circle. Our compatibility calculator compares two full birth dates, elements included.
2026 (Fire Horse, until 5 February 2027): for the Monkey, it has no special traditional relationship with the Horse, so 2026 is a neutral year.
2027 (Fire Goat, from 6 February 2027): for the Monkey, it has no special traditional relationship with the Goat, so 2027 is a neutral year. See Chinese zodiac 2027 predictions for every sign.

sections.h2: Other Year of the Monkey years
paras: Years of the same animal come every twelve years, each with a different element: 1968 (Earth Monkey); 1980 (Metal Monkey); 2004 (Wood Monkey); 2016 (Fire Monkey). The full list is in our Chinese zodiac years chart.

faq: 1992 is the Year of the Monkey, a Yang Water Monkey year (Ren-shen).
When does the 1992 Year of the Monkey start and end?
It starts on 4 February 1992 and ends on 22 January 1993.
I was born in January 1992. What is my Chinese zodiac?
A Goat: Lunar New Year 1992 was on 4 February 1992, so all of January 1992 belongs to the Goat year.
Water. 1992 ends in 2, which belongs to Water, and it is a Yang year.
Who is the Monkey compatible with?
Traditionally the Rat, Dragon and Snake. The Monkey's clash sign is the Tiger.
